summary: Iteration 63: Full backend + frontend validation of the 4 new SoD Command Center features — Alert Muting/Snoozing, Two-step Evidence Signoff, Score Forecast chip, and Per-Auditor Packs. Backend pytest (5/5 pass) exercises /scorecard forecast, /scorecard/why, mute→check→unmute, approve→unapprove, and evidence preview with auditor_scopes. Frontend Playwright E2E (all pass) drives login, forecast chip render, Why refresh, Snooze24h (with prompt dialog auto-accepted) → banner render → alert-check while muted (toast: 'Alerts muted — would flag score 53/100') → Un-mute now → banner clears + snooze buttons reappear; Prepared-by save → Approve pack (prompt) → status chip ✓ TEST Approver User · 2026-08-09 → Revoke → 'Pending approval'; Add scope → save → Preview pack → dialog shows 'test-auditor@example.com · 12 conflict(s) · scoped: Finance, S4P'. Regression testids (sod-table, sod-autorem, scorecard-export, scorecard-export-pdf, evidence-export-pdf, evidence-export-csv, sim-run) all visible.

issues: Radix DialogContent warnings in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. A11y-only, no functional impact.

features_verified.score_forecast: PASS — data-testid=scorecard-forecast renders 'Forecast next wk 56/100 (+3)' from GET /api/sap/scorecard (fields forecast.next_week_score=56, forecast.delta=+3). Chip color computed from delta sign.
features_verified.why_summary: PASS — data-testid=scorecard-why-text populated; scorecard-why-refresh triggers GET /api/sap/scorecard/why 200 and re-renders text.
features_verified.alert_muting: PASS — Snooze 24h opens window.prompt (accepted default 'Known dip — remediation in progress'). POST /api/sap/scorecard/alert-mute {hours:24} 200. Banner shows 'Alerts snoozed until 8/10/2026, 2:17:42 AM · Known dip — remediation in progress' with Un-mute button. Snooze 24h/7d buttons hidden while muted. Clicking Check & alert now while muted toasts 'Alerts muted — would flag score 53/100 · Governance score 53/100 below target 60/100 · Open Critical SoD 28 over limit 25' (no post). POST /api/sap/scorecard/alert-unmute 200 → banner disappears, Snooze24h/7d reappear.
features_verified.two_step_signoff: PASS — evidence-prepared-by='TEST Prep User' saved via digest-save (PUT /api/sap/digest/config 200). Approve pack opens prompt, entered 'TEST Approver User', POST /api/sap/sod-evidence/approve 200. Status chip = '✓ TEST Approver User · 2026-08-09' with Revoke button. POST /api/sap/sod-evidence/unapprove 200 returns state to 'Pending approval'.
features_verified.per_auditor_packs: PASS — auditor-scope-add appends row; email/areas/systems fields fill; PUT /api/sap/digest/config 200 (auditor_scopes list persisted with areas/systems split by comma server-side). evidence-preview opens dialog with evidence-preview-recipients showing 'Per-recipient delivery · test-auditor@example.com · 12 conflict(s) · scoped: Finance, S4P'.
features_verified.regression: PASS — sod-table, sod-autorem, scorecard-export, scorecard-export-pdf, evidence-export-pdf, evidence-export-csv, sim-run all visible. sod-mitigate-dialog trigger buttons using selector [data-testid^=sod-mitigate-btn-] returned 0 matches — likely the mitigate-per-row button uses a different testid convention; row-level dialog trigger not directly verified in this run but the mitigate dialog wiring was covered in prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent in evidence-preview-dialog and sod-mitigate-dialog to remove the console warnings.
(Optional) Confirm per-row mitigate trigger testid convention; if a stable per-row testid like 'sod-mitigate-btn-{ref}' is desired it doesn't currently exist — would help future automation.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/sap/digest/config accepts evidence_recipients only as list[str]; the frontend correctly splits the comma-string before PUT, but a direct API caller (or a future feature that forwards the string as-is) would 422. Consider a Pydantic validator that also accepts a comma-string for symmetry with recipients handling.

muteAlert uses window.prompt() — fine for admin utility, but a shadcn Dialog with an Input would be more consistent with the rest of the app UI (also easier for automated tests, no dialog handler needed).
seed_data_creation: Created & removed a temporary auditor_scope (test-auditor@example.com · Finance · S4P), temporarily set evidence_prepared_by='TEST Prep User' and approved/revoked. All cleaned up at end of test (auditor_scopes emptied, evidence_recipients/prepared_by cleared, evidence_approved_by revoked, alerts un-muted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iter63 features (forecast chip, mute/unmute banner+snooze buttons, two-step approve/revoke, per-auditor scopes preview) are fully wired end-to-end. Playwright pattern for window.prompt: register page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.ensure_future(handler(d))) with an async handler that awaits dialog.accept(val). The mute prompt is auto-accepted with default reason; the approver prompt returns 'TEST Approver User'. Regression run recorded mitigate_btns=0 — either the per-row mitigate testid pattern changed or requires a different selector; not a blocker for iter63.
rca of the issue: No issues to root cause. Only cosmetic a11y warning for Radix DialogContent missing Description.
